rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.

rules_evaluated.evidence: No cross-file positional callback appears in the body. Chunk 0's "The next small lecture names three places this kind of file ends up" and chunk 6's "The next small lecture walks the same shapes" are forward previews of upcoming content, not backward callbacks pointing at another file by position.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Chunk 1's "You ran a plan, two push-backs, a second-pass walk-down, and an approval" resolves against push-back-on-the-plan.md's current phases (per this file's own Arc note: "Picks up from: push-back-on-the-plan Phase 5"), which are present in the module's current exercise set.

rules_evaluated.evidence: No guess-before-reveal instructional structure appears anywhere in this file.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: "fires" recurs in chunks 0, 3, 4 ("so it fires when you want it"; "the choice is when the rules fire"; "a rule off the auto-load path needs a wire, or it sits silently on disk until something reads it") describing when a CLAUDE.md rule activates — ordinary engineering usage for rule/hook activation, same register as "surface" used as a verb, not the maintainer's compendium-firing dialect sense. No listed dialect terms (compendium, beat, mood, forcing function, surface-as-noun, Connections-as-proper-noun) appear in the body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Only one non-chrome bold survives: **Refinement** at its term-earning moment in chunk 5, per the file's own maintainer-attested 2026-07-09 emphasis pass. All other bolds are widget chrome (**Time:**, **What you do:**, **What you build:**, **The point:**, **Prompt**, **Note**, **What happened:**).
